messages:
mira: uploaded the latest mock for the trace detail actions — wondering about ordering and discoverability. link: https://redwood.test/figma/trace-detail
andrew: quick skim — main thing i noticed is export vs copy placement. export is hidden in the kebab, copy actions are inline. feels inconsistent.
sam: agreed. exporting a trace (for pm or support) is a top task. hiding it makes it harder to find during incidents.
jess: accessibility concern: the kebab has no visible label to screen readers in current build. need aria-labels.
mira: good point. propose: primary row of affordances = [Copy correlation id] [Open in new tab] [Export trace], then kebab for less-used actions (share, pin, annotate).
kai: :+1: on surface parity. Implementation note — export triggers a background job so it can be async; we should show a non-modal toast with progress link.
andrew: for copy actions, can we consolidate into a single overflow that expands on hover for mobile? mobile touch targets are tight.
jess: mobile needs larger hit areas. also keyboard nav: tab order should follow visual order of actions. currently copy is after export in tab order (wrong).
sam: small copy tweak: instead of "Copy ID" use "Copy correlation ID" (explicit). for stack frames: "Copy stack frame" -> "Copy frame location"? thoughts.
mira: agree on explicit labels. we should also show a short helper tooltip for first-time users: "Ctrl/C to copy correlation id" or similar.
designbot: accessibility scan: contrast issue on subtle icon button hover state at 2.8:1 (fails AA). recommended increase to 4.5:1 for icons with no text or add focus ring.
jess: add visible focus ring for keyboard users. use system outline color and 3px offset.
kai: technical question — copying correlation id also copies a short explanation? we should only copy raw id. support can use a separate "Copy with context" in kebab.
andrew: ordering question: should "Open in new tab" be left of export? i think flows: inspect -> open -> export. open is more immediate.
mira: layout proposal: [Copy ID] [Open in new tab] [Export] [Kebab]. primary actions left, secondary right. icons + text (text visible on hover on compact view).
sam: on compact narrow screens, collapse to icons only but add descriptive aria-label and long-press reveal text.
jess: example aria snippet for screen readers: `button aria-label=\"Copy correlation ID (press c)\"` and `a aria-label=\"Open trace in new tab\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\"`.
andrew: small keyboard shortcut map: c=copy, o=open, e=export, k=toggle kebab. add to keyboard help modal.
mira: action items: 1) design to update mock with new action order and explicit labels (mira). 2) eng to add aria-labels + focus styles + keyboard shortcuts (kai, andrew). 3) accessibility team to re-run scan after changes (jess). I'll drop updated figma by EOD.
jess: thanks — can we also include a11y note about announcing export job start for screen readers (live region)?
kai: yes, plan to use an ARIA live region: "Export started. Link to download will appear in notifications."
designbot: thread marked for review in next design crit on Monday. :calendar:
mira: thanks everyone — will post updated frames and a compact/mobile variant in thread. :thumbsup:
